title: Shop notification sent on migration for capability expansions and reductions
preconds: Migration complete. At least one role with documented capability expansions vs legacy (e.g., legacy SA No Reports → system-ssa which gains Reports access) and at least one with reductions.
steps:
1. 
2. Identify a user whose role gained capabilities (e.g., legacy SA No Reports → system-ssa).
3. Log in as that user. Check the in-app banner area for a migration notification.
4. Check the email inbox associated with that user.
5. Read the notification text.
6. Repeat for a user whose role lost capabilities.
expected: Notification is delivered via the channel(s) PM chose. The notification text explicitly describes both gains and losses for the user's specific role transition. If no notification is sent: file as P1 bug — SV-7527 explicitly requires this.
